reviews.text: This place is amazing! I had my dog spayed here a week ago and everything went great, thank God. The staff was super friendly. 100% recommend
This place is a God send for my fur babies! Everyone loves animals and are passionate about what they do.
Excellent service
Friendly Staff, affordable, took good care of my pet.
Wonderful, well-care vet services at reasonable rates.  Excellent and knowledge-driven professional staff.

Summer 2026 Update: I still love Emancipet! I have been taking my pets here for 4 years now. This clinic is an amazing option for anyone looking for low cost fixing or vaccines. THEY DO NOT SEE SICK PETS! I love that I can bring all my cats here and have them fully vaccinated for under $100 each. The vets, assistants, and front staff are always very kind and undsranding. I also LOVE the new appointment system, as in previous years we used to have to wait a few hours to be seen. The lower wait time helps both me and my pets as they don't have to spend as much time in their carriers. Also as a first time cat owner, the staff has helped answer my cat care questions over the years which is much appreciated. I have had 3 cats have their spay/neuter here and everything has gone well.

Fall 2022: I just came here for some kitten vaccines and I totally recommend it! I came in the middle of the day and even though it was busy, my whole trip was less than 20 minutes. The staff are super friendly and are happy to answer questions. I didn't know what my kitten needed and they were happy to give me recommendations and explanations. The prices are very affordable compared to what many vets offer!
Awesome experience every time. Very nice, professional and great prices.
Excellent service!
Inexpensive and helpful staff. Took care of my dogs, in and out. Still our go-to for our pets shots and check ups.
Very good service
Really nice  worker's  so helpful
I had the best experience, staff was kind and efficient. The doctor was knowledgeable and kind. They truly care for your animals.

Excellent service, very kind, and they gave me a lot of confidence leaving my babies in their care. Their bastek surgery was excellent; my baby recovered very quickly, and their staff were very kind from the moment we arrived until we got our babies back. Thank you.

Bella and I are thrilled with this clinic. It's the best!! I love how they treat Bella with such tenderness and dedication. I think it's the only Emancipet clinic that's actually good. Last week I visited another Emancipet branch and they treated me terribly and refused to see Bella because she didn't have an appointment, even though I never make an appointment for Bella and they always see her. Today, Friday, June 12th, I went to this clinic and I'm speechless with gratitude to everyone there.
I've been coming to this clinic for over a year now and will continue to do so. Thank you!
My dog got neutered here and he’s reactive. This staff was so good with him. I recommend them to everyone
Excellent place, professionalism and love!!! 100% recommended

I brought my cat here to be spayed and I’m not going to lie, the line made me nervous. I had the usual “this isn’t personable enough for me” thoughts but it’s the aftercare that changed my opinion on Emancipet.

On a SUNDAY, I became very concerned because my cat’s gums started looking pale and her breathing looked really off to me. The after hours number was super supportive!! They ended up reaching out to Dr. Cooke on my behalf who in turn reached out to me directly. She was super understanding and compassionate all while being helpful.

As the night went on, my concerns grew and when I reached out yet again, they immediately found an emergency clinic for me to take my baby too. There were no questions or feelings of whether this was my anxiety or not.

On top of that, I was fully prepared to cover part of the cost (separate testings are not covered in the post treatment) but was completely surprised when Dr. Cooke reached out to follow up on Fiona as well as inform me they’d be covering the cost as part of her post treatment. So happy, so pleased. Because of the support and the care, I highly recommend and would feel very comfortable dropping Fiona off again.

My only hold up in the awful cloth cone they gave me. It didn’t stay on at all. The unflattering plastic route would’ve been my choice had I been given one.
I love this place. They’re so nice professional there are affordable, but please donate after your visit. It doesn’t matter if it’s a dollar or five dollars make sure to donate to support!!!!
We had our dog and cat spayed and neutered there and very happy with pricing and all.

I love Emancipet, no matter which one I take my fur babies to, they are treated with love.

I love Emancipet, no matter which one I take my fur babies to, they are treated with love.
The friendly staff. The cat surgery was successful
Excellent service

These people are so amazing I cannot thank them enough , we have recently found a dog and she is very reactive to other dogs , I was so nervous to bring her in, the receptionist was amazing , she made sure no dogs were around when it was our turn , the vet and everyone there were so helpful and understanding. I cannot recommend them enough!!
Great service and good prices, my dog ​​and I are delighted with this place
Thanks to doc
I got my dog spayed, no issues, great price, they even trimmed her nails for her
A wonderful veterinary clinic. They have been taking care of my Toy Poodle for his basic needs for years. We get in and out and it’s super affordable. I’m very grateful to have them around!
Good service.

Could use better customer service at the front. I called 4 times to see if I could schedule an appointment. Never answered so i made one online. When I showed up the not so nice lady at the front desk said we are not taking appointments. Only walk ins. I asked what is the wait time. She said well 3 to 4 hours and we close at 6 with an attitude. I asked when can I come back she said not til Wednesday(it's Saturday) overall bad experience

Not a full service veterinarian clinic. You pay 20 dollars to get a check up; from what the receptionist says the veterinarian would not be able to properly diagnose a rash. They do not have the resources to prescribe anything for a cut or rash much less the confidence of a simple diagnosis. Im not taking anything out of context or complaining out of anger its just what the receptionist told me - they probably wouldn't be able to get a proper diagnosis and cant prescribe the right medicine. The wait is going to be over an hour for the walk in. If something is wrong with your baby dont come here, they can not help.

Very reasonable pricing for vaccines and care when it comes to actual veterinary care! You save at least 50% of your money! I want to say my dogs overall shots cost me $120 at the high end? I  did get the comparison to the veterinary clinic and I believe  it would have been $575? No question about future visits? This is the best place for your pet!!

Another great experience ! Thank you !
We have taken 3 Rescued pets here and one cat we had dumped here. Clean - fast and reasonable - thank you Emancipet - Houston needs you !
Stray Cat spay was about $149 all in, with chip & flea treatment.
Affordable place!  Nice employees
very caring team

I would like to sincerely thank Dr. MacKay, Litzy, and Charles for the exceptional care they provided. Their patience, compassion, and professionalism in caring for my two dogs—a French bulldog and a miniature schnauzer—were truly remarkable.

They took the time to ensure my dogs felt comfortable, allowing them to acclimate at their own pace. Their knowledge and thoughtful approach, including finding a treat that helped keep my dog calm and cooperative, made it possible to successfully complete the appointment.

I am genuinely grateful not only for the care they showed my dogs, but also for the kindness and understanding they extended to us as pet owners. Their empathy toward the concerns and worries that come with caring for our pets made a meaningful difference.

I sincerely hope they are recognized by the organization for their outstanding work, and I wish each of them continued happiness and success in life.

It had been years since I owned a dog but because of my first amazing experience with them I wanted to use them again. I cannot possibly express the efficiency, the caring people that work there, and ultimately the excellent outcomes. I took my 3 year old dog to be neutered at 8 am and received a message that he was done around 12:15. He was able to get all of his vaccines which he had never had before so I feel so much better that he is protected. I’ve always said that any vet bill under $500 should be considered free.bc we have all had terrible experiences however this place for 5 vaccines, meds, and the surgery was less than $250. Can’t beat it.
Took my two cats there! Taking my other two next week

I've been going to Emancipet since 2021 and I keep recommending my friends and family to their clinic.
The customer service is beyond 5 stars! The veterinarian assistants are gentle with my family dogs and cats. They help them calm down with treats and pet, truly wonderful ladies! The doctors have amazing skills and they answer every little question I had about my pets; they're patient and truy have a passion to help our fluffy babies!
We had a great experience here! Simple and cost effective animal care. Very much recommended this place.

Amazing customer service from start to finish. Dropped in for vaccination of my cats and experienced minimal waiting time. Front desk staff is very attentive and welcoming. The vet assistant handled the cats so calmly and efficiently, rarely experienced a vaccination go this smooth. ❤️ I’ll definitely come back again and I’ll happily add donations for this non profit when shopping at PetSmart
The staff always nice and professional and low cost medication
Great service & adorable. I took my cats

I’ve always had great experiences at Emancipet. The staff is kind and caring with my dogs, and the prices are very affordable. The only downside is the wait time without an appointment (around 3 hours), but overall it’s worth it.
Love the staff they're always nice so friendly you can tell they really love their job and our pets
Excellent service for my pets
The staff were very well organized and pleasant. They were extremely busy but stopped to help me vest my hyper pup. Pup was very well taken care of.

I paid $20 for each of my dogs so they could see the doctors for a check up since they are both prone to ear infections i expressed that to the doctor and her assistant any other vet I’ve been to uses an otoscope and thoroughly checks the dogs including the vet visits that i have paid a mere $9 per check up however all emancipet did was check their temp and lifted their ears looked and said they were fine no otoscope no flash light no nothing i know they advertise affordable vet care however that does not give you the right to sweep me or my pets under the rug if you do not care about pets health perhaps consider a different profession because like i said before my pets have received far more throughout check ups in vet clinics that cost $9 per check up extremely disappointed and dissatisfied at emancipets services beginning with front desk who feels entitled to your respect although they don't show it back i came here so my dogs would receive a check up and an expression which the doctors assistant quickly tried to tell me they don’t do even though its on their menu i also told them one of my dogs suffers with allergies which she takes allergy shots for as well as has a special shampoo with ketoconazole to help her with itchiness they proceeded to tell me that she doesn’t need that shampoo because they didn't see an issue with her skin first of all they never even looked at her fur or skin and second if they did she didn’t have any issues because i have been using that shampoo on her religiously for the past year which i also told them they proceeded to tell me that if i did see an issue with her fur to come back mind you i live 40 minutes away i came here because i thought they were a good affordable clinic but instead they would rather make me pay another $20 vet visit so she can receive her medicinal shampoo if you are looking for an affordable good vet that actually cares for your pets go elsewhere because they don’t truly care for your pets health here emancipet will not be receiving a single penny from me again if thats how they treat pets Infront of their owners i would hate to see how they treat them behind closed doors
Very kind and professional, prices are amazing as well!!!

I always bring my dog here for her shots and flea medicine. The process is just like Banfield except they’re a low cost vet so they are not full service. The prices are reasonable and service is typically fast. The vets are really nice to my dog. In the video they were treating her ear infection so i requested a muzzle
They took great care of my feral kitten while she was getting spayed. Affordable services & great staff!
Amazing staff and vets. People actually care here. Amazing products and prices I tell everyone about them!!!!!
I had a dog, 62 pounds and a cat, 12 pounds for neuter surgery and they both are doing great one day after the surgery.
Fast, friendly, inexpensive. Very easy online scheduling. Highly recommend!
100% recommended, excellent price on vaccines for dogs and very good service from all the girls
Caring and able Vet staff made us comfortable and answered questions. Very professional and it's a blessing having them available.
Brought Rudy in for a well check staff was very patient and kind listened to our needs Rudy had an ingrown toenail that I could not cut.
The place is awesome. Amazing staff and prices.
Great fast service no lines and great doc
I love it because they help with the cost of medicine; there's just one more thing missing, but you can't ask for more.
Very affordable, super friendly, I loved it

Very convenient location for us! We're first-time cat parents (we took in a stray), and we've had a great experience with Emancipet. The services offered are excellent, and the staff at this location has been wonderful. On our third visit, we had the pleasure of meeting Sulem (I believe she’s a vet tech), who took fantastic care of our cat, Cheddar. Amazingly, Cheddar even let Sulem trim her claws — a first for us! Great service and reasonable prices overall. Highly recommend it.
An excellent clinic at a good price

The service here is unreasonably expensive, and the receptionist was extremely rude. They sent multiple email reminders about an appointment, but when I arrived, they claimed they couldn’t provide the service. Total waste of time.

The vet seemed inexperienced — my kitten bled after a simple injection, which should have been done gently and professionally. What’s worse, instead of cleaning the injection site properly with alcohol, they used a dirty rag (the kind you wipe tables with). I’m now seriously worried my kitten might get an infection.

To make matters worse, what they say on the phone and what they say in person are completely different. Very unprofessional. I will definitely not be coming back and do not recommend this place to anyone who truly cares about their pet.
Great vets to take care of our doggies.

She made me wait longer I asked to see a doctor and she said no you don’t need to see one today it’s just a booster !!
I said I am paying for it and she kept saying oh so you want to wait another 30 minutes ? This is after I waited for almost 3  hours !
They didn’t have name tag so I had to ask her name and I asked front to know her name and she mentioned she cannot disclose the technician name which having name tag is a must in health care !
The older team were amazing this new team they have is reduculus

Excellent. Got a walk in appointment for rabies shot and check-up after a fight. Took no time at all. Good price. Friendly and professional.
The address I see on Petsmart is correct

My first experience was perfect: 10/10. It was fast, organized, and the communication was great. I had one of my cats spayed that day. I made a second visit for vaccinations, which they say you don't need an appointment for. Well, that day I couldn't really get anything done. After I was there with my cat, they told me they were going to put me on a waiting list, and after receiving a message, I could wait in the waiting room. I asked if the wait would be long, and the answer was yes. So, to avoid stressing my cat, I went home. No more than five minutes had passed when, while I was on the highway, I received the message. I couldn't read it until I got home; it was the message saying it was my turn. I didn't go back! I could have waited in the parking lot that long, but the woman said I would have to wait too long! I'll try again another day to see if different staff are there, since they weren't the same ones as when I visited the first time.
athe wait time at this location is less than an hour’s great customer service.
Amazing customer service and great staff.

Emancipet said they can do her booster no problem, and when we got there, they ended up doing 3 vaccines for about $75.
